newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Jan 28.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Jan 28.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Philippine stocks on Tuesday:
* On Monday, the Dow Jones dropped 35.79 points to 6,660.69. PLDT's ADR fell by $0 3/4 to $56 3/4.
* The peso closed at 26.337 to a U.S. dollar from 26.339.
* The Philippine Stock Exchange index fell to 3,323.10, down 9.43 points.
* The Philippine interbank call loan average rate was steady at 10.53125 pct.

* The Businessworld newspaper said the Court of Appeals yesterday upheld a Board of Investments ruling approving JG Summit Petrochemical Corp's decision to establish a petrochemical plant in Batangas city.
* Security Bank reported a net income of 904.381 million pesos in 1996 from the year-ago 501.796 million.
* PCI Leasing and Finance Inc said on Monday its unaudited net income reached 261.299 million pesos in 1996 from the year-ago audited net of 140 million.
